data: Is the dialog system designed to handle interactions between four users?

The figure shows two users, User A and User B, interacting with each other through a dialog system. The flow of communication is depicted with arrows connecting various components of the system. The system includes processes like ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition), SLU (Speech Language Understanding), Parser, OOV/Name Detection, Answer Merging, Error Processing, Sense Detection, MT (Machine Translation), and TTS (Text-to-Speech). The dialog manager coordinates these processes. There is no indication of handling more than two users in the figure or caption. Therefore, based on the provided information, the dialog system is not designed to handle interactions between four users.
